prose: Basis: Bloomberg blocks automated fetching (HTTP 403), so this note rests on Techmeme's account of a DongA Ilbo report. SK Hynix gained about $15 billion on its Kioxia stake earlier in 2026 and plans to return roughly $12 billion of it to shareholders through a special dividend. The prospect alone was enough for the memory maker's shares to buck a broad selloff in AI-related stocks - a reminder of how much of the AI boom's value is sitting in memory silicon.
highlights: SK Hynix gained ~$15B on its Kioxia stake earlier in 2026, per DongA Ilbo
It plans a ~$12B special dividend to shareholders
The news lifted its shares against a broad AI-stock selloff
Bloomberg blocks fetching (HTTP 403); note based on Techmeme's summary
